name: Fabric Extensibility Toolkit - Admin Portal Workload Managment
description: Introducing Workload Management in the Fabric Admin PortalTenant administrators can now discover and manage Extensibility workloads from a single, centralized experience in the Admin Portal.What's NewManage tab with searchable, filterable workloads tableEach workload has a detail panel for inspection and action, which includes:Consent - Pre-consent the entire tenantManage workload availability in the tenant by capacities and workspaces
